'''Ravn''' was a group of six [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were part of a convoy under the escort of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Stalwart (Victory-class)|Stalwart]] to bring building materials and supplies to construct a space installation called [[NL-1]] to bring order to the [[Pakuuni system/Legends|Pakuuni system]] which was wroth with [[Pakuuni Pirates|Pirates]], under the support of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].
